वादा

Translation status: हिन्दी reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the hi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Promise-like result type associated with async finite functions.

Aliases: promise

Syntax: वादा<T> | वादा<T ⇥ E>

Category#

async

radix/corpus/promissum/promissum.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Promise-like result type associated with async finite functions.

# =============================================================================
# वादा — Promise-like result type associated with async finite functions.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Async return type — `वादा<T>` is the return-type wrapper for `async`
#     functions and compatibility `@ भविष्य` functions.
#   • Failable async return type — `वादा<T ⇥ E>` preserves both the
#     resolved value and delayed alternate channel.
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Creating a `वादा<T>` but never awaiting it with `रुको_स्थिर`,
#     `रुको_चर`, `रुको_लौटाओ`, or `रुको` — the promise goes unobserved.
#
# See also: async, भविष्य, रुको_स्थिर, रुको
# =============================================================================

# वादा<T> — async result type (paired with async)
#
# फलन … async → <प्रकार>       -- lowers to वादा<<प्रकार>>
# फलन … async → <प्रकार> ⇥ E   -- lowers to वादा<<प्रकार> ⇥ E>
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   futuraDecl :← funcDecl 'async'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   वादा प्रकार notus (promissum.expected).

fn compute() async → int {
    return 7
}

main {
    print "promissum typus notus"
}

Expected output:

promissum typus notus
